caption: Steam from a hot shower drifts against the cool tiled wall, and the tiles bead with water that runs in streaks.

sa.check: Steam drifts against a tiled wall.
The water runs down in streaks.
The steam comes from a hot shower.
The beading comes first and the streaks follow.

pc.expect: The drops join and run downward over the tiles and gather at the grout lines and the wall's foot.
pc.fail: A streak runs up the tiles; or water gathers along the wall's top and stays; or a drop leaves the tiles and rises; or a streak travels sideways and stays level.

pc.expect: The beading only builds while steam keeps arriving, and runs only advance downward.
pc.fail: The tiles dry while steam still drifts against them; or the beads grow and shrink in turn; or the tiles are wet before any steam reaches them; or a streak retreats up the wall.

pc.expect: The tiles are wet where the steam reaches them and drier where it does not.
pc.fail: The wall beads evenly all over while the steam drifts against one part; or the tiles bead in a corner the steam never reaches; or the steam drifts against the tiles and they stay dry to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: The drops behave as water on glazed tile: rounded, merging when they touch and running as streaks, and the grout darkens as it wets.
pc.fail: Touching drops overlap without merging; or drops jump about on the tile; or the water sets as frost on the warm wall; or the tiles' glaze bubbles as the water runs.

pc.expect: The wall keeps its tiles in their courses and nothing passes through it.
pc.fail: A tile vanishes; or a new tile appears; or water passes through the wall; or the wall changes shape.

pc.expect: The tiles' colour and pattern away from the wet area and the fittings stay the same.
pc.fail: The tiles change colour; or the pattern changes; or the fittings move.
